description: Add a note to a contact. Provide contact_id OR email plus title + description. Types: note, call, email, meeting, quote. Description supports HTML.

label: Bulk Create or Update Contacts
source: Batch create/update up to 500 contacts.
description: Batch create/update up to 500 contacts. Returns per-row {created, updated, skipped, invalid}. auto_create defaults to true here (matches CSV-import expectations) — opposite of upsert-contact.

label: Change Campaign Status
source: State transition.
description: State transition. schedule + delete are destructive. pause/resume only valid mid-send (working↔paused). unschedule reverts to draft and clears scheduled_at.

label: Delete Contact Note
source: Delete a single subscriber note by id.
description: Delete a single subscriber note by id. Find the note id via get-contact include=["notes"]. Other notes and email history are untouched.

label: Estimate Dynamic Segment
source: Count contacts matching a filter (no rows returned).
description: Count contacts matching a filter (no rows returned). For "who will receive a campaign" pass statuses=["subscribed"] — campaigns only send to subscribed. Or use upsert-campaign.estimated_recipients which scopes to subscribed automatically.

label: Get Automation
source: Funnel details with sequences and per-step report by default.
description: Funnel details with sequences and per-step report by default. Embedded email bodies in send_custom_email steps are stripped unless include_bodies=true (saves tokens).

label: Get CRM Context
source: Discovery.
description: Discovery. Returns identity, permissions, stats, top tags/lists, available triggers/actions, all enums, custom fields schema, default sender. Call once per session.

label: Manage List
source: Create, update, delete, or merge lists.
description: Create, update, delete, or merge lists. delete + merge are destructive (re-pivot or detach subscribers).

label: Manage Tag
source: Create, update, delete, or merge tags.
description: Create, update, delete, or merge tags. delete + merge are destructive (re-pivot or detach subscribers).

label: Send Email to Contact
source: Send a one-off email to a subscribed/transactional contact.
description: Send a one-off email to a subscribed/transactional contact. Routes through normal queue + bounce + FluentSMTP. SmartCodes resolve. Persists a custom_email_campaign record (hidden from list-campaigns by default).

label: Send Test Email
source: Render and send a test copy of an email — does not enroll the recipient, does not create a campaign record, does not log to email_history.
description: Render and send a test copy of an email — does not enroll the recipient, does not create a campaign record, does not log to email_history. Subject is prefixed with "TEST:".

label: Update Contact Automation Status
source: Resume, cancel, or advance_now a contact in a funnel.
description: Resume, cancel, or advance_now a contact in a funnel. cancel is destructive (reversible in UI but halts processing). advance_now requires advance_to_sequence_id and skips intermediate benchmarks.

label: Create or Update Campaign
source: Create or update a draft campaign.
description: Create or update a draft campaign. Never sends — use change-campaign-status to schedule. recipients persists tags + lists ONLY (no statuses/contact_type — apply a temp tag first). Returns estimated_recipients + warnings inline.

label: Create or Update Contact
source: Create or update a contact by id or email.
description: Create or update a contact by id or email. status changes fire native hooks. Source stamps "mcp" only on create — preserved on update. new_email renames in place.

label: Add redaction keyword
source: Add a custom keyword to Bucket 2 (payment / regulated) or Bucket 3 (contact PII).
description: Add a custom keyword to Bucket 2 (payment / regulated) or Bucket 3 (contact PII). Strengthens defaults — no confirmation required. Bucket 1 is hardcoded and not addable.

label: Exempt ability from Bucket 3 redaction
source: Allow contact PII (email, phone, address, IP) to flow through one specific ability's response.
description: Allow contact PII (email, phone, address, IP) to flow through one specific ability's response. Requires in-chat 1/2 confirmation. Bucket 2 exemptions are admin-UI only.

label: Get redaction list
source: Read the current redaction configuration: master toggle, bucket-1/2/3 keyword lists, per-ability exemptions.
description: Read the current redaction configuration: master toggle, bucket-1/2/3 keyword lists, per-ability exemptions. No friction.

label: Remove custom redaction keyword
source: Reverse a previously-added custom keyword (Bucket 2 or 3).
description: Reverse a previously-added custom keyword (Bucket 2 or 3). Reversal of operator additions only — does not remove default keywords. No confirmation required.

label: Remove default Bucket 3 keyword

description: Weaken the default Bucket 3 redaction list by removing a default keyword. Requires in-chat 1/2 confirmation. Bucket 2 default removal is not available via abilities — it is admin-UI only.

label: Restore redaction defaults

description: Restore Bucket 2 + Bucket 3 redaction lists to factory defaults. Clears custom additions and removed-defaults. No confirmation required (strengthens safety).

label: Re-lock ability under Bucket 3
source: Remove a previously-granted Bucket 3 exemption.
description: Remove a previously-granted Bucket 3 exemption. Strengthens safety — no confirmation required.

description: Archive (soft-delete) a SureCart product by its ID. Archived products are hidden from the storefront but can be restored later. This does not delete the product permanently.

label: Create Invoice
source: Create a new SureCart invoice for a customer.
description: Create a new SureCart invoice for a customer. Requires a customer ID, a price ID for the line item, and a due date. For multi-variant products, a variant_id is required to specify which variant to invoice. Optionally set a custom ad-hoc amount, quantity, and a memo/description. The invoice is created in draft status and then opened so the customer can pay.

label: Delete Fulfillment

description: Permanently delete a SureCart fulfillment record by its ID. This removes the fulfillment and its tracking information. Requires explicit confirmation. This action cannot be undone.

label: Delete Promotion

description: Permanently delete a SureCart promotion code by its ID. This removes the promotion code so it can no longer be used at checkout. Requires explicit confirmation. This action cannot be undone.

description: Retrieve a single SureCart abandoned checkout by its ID, including its checkout, line items, customer, promotion, and recovered checkout (if any). Returns the full abandoned checkout object with related data expanded.

description: Retrieve a single SureCart fulfillment item by its ID, including the parent fulfillment and associated line item. Returns the fulfillment item with related data expanded.

description: Retrieve SureCart order and sales statistics for a given date range and interval. Returns time-series data points for revenue, order count, and average order value.

description: Retrieve a comprehensive SureCart store health summary including total revenue, order count, and recent activity for a given date range and interval. Useful for high-level reporting.

description: Retrieve the current SureCart store (account) information including store name, currency, URL, branding settings, and entitlements. Returns a single account object.

description: Update an existing SureCart fulfillment by its ID. Supports changing the shipment status, tracking information, and fulfillment items.

description: Update an existing SureCart invoice. Can modify the due date, issue date, memo, footer, and email notification preference. Can also change the invoice status to "open" (sends to customer) or "draft" (reverts to editable). When opening, use notifications_enabled to control whether the customer receives an email.

label: Update Promotion

description: Update an existing SureCart promotion by its ID. Supports changing the promotion code, associated coupon, and customer restriction. Only provided fields are updated.

description: Extend an active subscription's renewal date by a specified number of days or to a custom date. This does not cancel or restart the subscription — it simply pushes the next billing date forward, keeping the subscription active. Useful for granting free time to subscribers.
